A sample page for the capture

This page stands in for a variant a maker would write. It keeps every file inside its own directory, uses fonts the host already has, and reads comfortably at a narrow, a middle and a wide screen.

First section

The capture loads this file with every request intercepted, scrolls through it once so that late content settles, and then records one tile per screen height for each section. The paragraph is long enough to wrap onto several lines at every width, which is what the line-length row measures.

A second paragraph gives the body-size row more than one element to compare, and keeps the section taller than a single phone screen so that the narrow width yields more than one tile for it.

Second section

Nothing on this page moves once reduced motion is requested: the small rule above the title grows in only when motion is allowed, and that is the difference the second set of frames is there to show. The text colour and the paper colour are far enough apart to pass the contrast rows with room.

Sample footer. No names, no prices, no external address.
